title: Privacy: after an erase, a failed write of the erased record to this phone is retried, then the phone's copy is removed again
evidence: ios/engine/cloud.ts keepErasedOnPhone: after an erase the cloud took, the session has already removed the phone's file (eraseSession, host.mirror.wipe, __native.phoneRemove). The erased record then goes in its place. Before, a failed write was swallowed (saveRecordInto(...).catch(() => {})); a relaunch opened empty, or on the pre-erase copy if the first remove had also failed silently (PhoneFiles.swift try? removeItem, a Void native). Now the write is tried twice; when both fail, phoneRemove runs again, so a pre-erase copy a first remove left behind is gone. Also, packages/health-core/src/record-session.ts persist: the failure mirror write (the erase the cloud did not take, among others) is tried twice before it is given up, with no new mode (S57 left this for S54). No Swift change, no contract field, no new words: builds 11 and 12 run the new engine. Trade, stated: a write that landed but failed its verify read twice is removed too, so the next offline launch opens empty rather than on the erased record; merge keeps any later edit (merge.ts erasedAt), so nothing pre-erase returns. NOT fixed, stated: a pre-erase phone file that survives two failed writes and two failed removes stays, and the app says nothing of it (its words: lead S61). Checks: ios/engine/cloud.test.ts (cloudErase, lead S54: one failed write, two failed writes with a re-remove, the residual pinned, and the refused erase kept after one failed mirror write). US-11, US-25 AC16
